series: New listing #23, Oct 7; H03 hidden cost (benchmark: 20-mile Short, 717 views)
hook: A 60-mile round trip adds $175 to a junk haul quote
hook_say: Here is what a long drive to the job and the dump really adds to a half truck load.

rows.label: Job
rows.why: The calculator's example job: a half truck load, picked from the Trade Presets list.

rows.label: Hours on site, people
rows.why: Two people, an hour and a half on site each, with $75 of supplies and dump fees.

rows.label: Quote at 30 miles round trip
rows.why: At the preset 30-mile round trip, the price floor is $409.62 and the quote, with a 15% profit margin rounded up to the next $5, is $485.

rows.label: Round-trip miles
rows.why: Change the round trip to 60 miles. At 30 mph that is 2 hours of driving for each of the 2 people, plus $45.60 of vehicle cost at 76 cents a mile.

rows.label: Price floor at 60 miles
rows.why: Labor on site $187.09, drive time $249.45, vehicle $45.60 and supplies $75: the floor rises from $409.62 to $557.14.

rows.label: Quote at 60 miles round trip
rows.why: The quote moves from $485 to $660. Price the half load the same as a nearby job and the extra drive comes out of your pay.
